name: CrewAI Skills
summary: Official CrewAI Agent Skills for project setup, agent/task design, Flows, tools/MCP, tests and CrewAI AMP deploy. MIT; install via the Claude Code marketplace.
description: Official skills pack for the already-listed CrewAI framework (crewAIInc/skills). The repository is MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 crewAI, Inc.), not archived. The pack is free to install. The deploy-to-amp and call-deployed-crew skills target CrewAI AMP (the hosted platform) and HTTP kickoff of a deployed crew; AMP billing follows CrewAI's product terms (see the crewai entry) and was not re-verified here. No deploy or spend was made. This skills entry does not set mcp_endpoint. The README documents only a Claude Code marketplace install: `/plugin marketplace add crewAIInc/skills` then `/plugin install crewai-skills@crewai-plugins` (optional `#<ref>` pin). Those commands were not run. No npx install is documented in the README. Ten skills: getting-started, design-agent, design-task, ask-docs, check-crewai-api, build-flow, connect-tools-and-mcp, test-crewai-project, deploy-to-amp and call-deployed-crew. check-crewai-api is documented as checked against crewai 1.15.22 and 1.15.23; each skill names the crewai release it was verified against and tells the assistant to re-check with ask-docs when `crewai version` differs. test-crewai-project covers tracing and telemetry environment-variable values for testing a CrewAI project; that is documentation of the framework, not a telemetry claim about this skills repo.

agent_access.notes: Public MIT pack. Documented Claude Code marketplace install (`/plugin marketplace add crewAIInc/skills` then `/plugin install crewai-skills@crewai-plugins`) was not executed. AMP deploy/kickoff skills can touch the hosted CrewAI AMP platform; no deploy or spend was used. This entry does not set mcp_endpoint.
